items.name: Puxada Alta por Trás da Nuca (Uso específico/mobilidade)
items.movement: Seated BEHIND-NECK LAT PULLDOWN, rear camera: wide bar starts above head, bend elbows pulling bar BEHIND head to upper-neck level, return overhead. Head/torso neutral fixed, cable from high pulley above bar. Bar always behind head not chest.

items.name: Sissy Squat no Aparelho / Suporte de Pés
items.movement: Supported SISSY SQUAT on sissy bench: feet on floor locked under ankle pads, calves against vertical pad. Torso and thighs form straight line leaning backward as knees flex forward, then rise. Hips stay extended, hands chest. Show fixed ankle/calves support.

items.name: Empurrada de Trenó (Sled Push) / Puxada de Trenó de Costas (Backward Sled Drag)
items.movement: SLED PUSH: standing behind weighted sled, hands on two vertical handles, torso leaning forward, alternating steps push sled FORWARD across floor. Full athlete sled and floor visible, side camera. Six sequential alternating gait poses.

items.name: Cadeira Flexora Unilateral
items.movement: UNILATERAL SEATED LEG CURL machine: back against seat, thigh restraint across thighs, one RIGHT ankle on movable roller. Start right knee extended, bend right knee down/back against roller to90degrees, return. LEFT leg rests relaxed off roller and never moves.

items.name: Flexão Nórdica (Nordic Hamstring Curl)
items.movement: NORDIC HAMSTRING CURL: kneel on padded mat, ankles fixed under solid horizontal padded anchor behind. Torso/thighs straight from head to knees. Lean entire body FORWARD via knee extension under control to45degrees, then return upright. No hip hinge. Arms crossed chest, no unsupported full horizontal drop.

items.name: Extensão de Quadril Reversa na Máquina (Reverse Hyperextension)
items.movement: REVERSE HYPEREXTENSION machine: lie prone torso/pelvis on high flat padded platform, hands grasp fixed handles FRONT, both legs hang beyond rear edge. Padded strap across ankles attached pendulum arm. Raise straight legs backward to horizontal aligned torso, lower. Torso remains supported no lumbar hyperextension.

items.name: Agachamento Reverência no Smith
items.movement: SMITH CURTSY LUNGE: bar on upper back moves on TWO vertical rails. Standing RIGHT foot planted, LEFT leg steps DIAGONALLY behind RIGHT leg into cross-back curtsy, lower knees then rise and return left foot. Front camera shows crossed legs. Same lead leg all frames.

items.name: Afundo no Smith com Pé de Trás Apoiado no Step e Tronco Inclinado
items.movement: Smith rear-foot-elevated split squat: bar upper back attached vertical rails, rear LEFT foot on LOW STEP behind, front RIGHT foot floor. Slight torso forward lean, lower body bending front knee then rise. Both feet fixed, rear foot never leaves step.

items.name: Cadeira Abdutora com Tronco Inclinado à Frente
items.movement: Seated HIP ABDUCTION machine leaning torso FORWARD30degrees: knees bent90degrees, OUTER knees against two movable pads. Start knees close, spread knees outward against pads then close. Feet fixed to footrests moving with machine arms, torso stays leaning forward.

items.name: Desenvolvimento por Trás da Nuca no Smith
items.movement: BEHIND-NECK SMITH shoulder press seated: REAR camera, bar BEHIND head at upper-neck level attached TWO vertical guide rails. Wide grip press overhead straight arms, lower behind head. Torso head fixed neutral, bar never in front face.

items.name: Desenvolvimento com Barra Suíça (Pegada Neutra)
items.movement: Seated SWISS BAR neutral-grip shoulder press: rectangular multi-grip bar with parallel inner handles, palms facing each other. Bar starts upper chest in FRONT head, press overhead then lower. Back supported bench, feet floor, bar construction identical.

items.name: Elevação Lateral na Polia Baixa (Cabo passando pela frente do corpo)
items.movement: Single-arm LOW cable lateral raise cable IN FRONT body: pulley on athlete LEFT, RIGHT hand starts near left front thigh cable crosses FRONT pelvis. Raise RIGHT arm laterally out to right shoulderheight stretching cable away from tower, return. Fixed slight elbow bend, torso fixed.

items.name: Elevação Lateral na Polia Baixa (Cabo passando por trás do corpo)
items.movement: Single-arm LOW cable lateral raise cable BEHIND body: pulley on athlete LEFT, RIGHT hand starts behind right hip cable crosses BEHIND pelvis. Raise right arm out to right shoulderheight away from tower then lower. REAR camera shows cable BEHIND hips, fixed torso.

items.name: Elevação Lateral na Polia na Altura do Quadril/Punho (Maior tensão no início)
items.movement: Single-arm cable lateral raise with pulley AT WRIST/HIP HEIGHT not floor. Pulley at left hip level, right hand starts by left hip across FRONT body, raise right arm laterally to right shoulderheight then lower. Cable near horizontal initially, torso fixed.

items.name: Remada para Deltoide Posterior na Polia ou Smith (Rear Delt Row)
items.movement: Seated HIGH CABLE rear-delt ROW: pulley at shoulder height in FRONT, wide straight bar overhand grip, upper arms flared90degrees sideways. Pull bar toward upper chest by bending elbows and retracting shoulders, then extend arms. Torso upright fixed. Distinguish row from fly.

items.name: Rosca Deitado no Chão na Polia Baixa (Lying Cable Curl)
items.movement: SUPINE FLOOR low cable biceps curl: lie back on mat with FEET toward LOW pulley, arms straight beside torso hands hold straight bar above thighs. Upper arms on mat fixed, bend elbows pulling bar toward chest, extend back. No crunch torso stays floor.

items.name: Rosca na Polia Alta Deitado no Banco (Puxando em direção à testa)
items.movement: SUPINE BENCH HIGH cable biceps curl: lie back flat bench with HEAD toward high pulley behind head, upper arms point vertically up fixed, hold straight bar. Flex elbows lowering bar toward FOREHEAD then extend upward toward pulley. Torso fixed bench, not triceps extension (cable pulls up).

items.name: Rosca Bíceps no TRX / Argolas
items.movement: SUSPENSION BICEPS CURL: standing facing anchor with body leaning BACK straight head-to-heel, feet planted, hold two suspension handles arms extended shoulderheight. Keep elbows shoulderheight fixed, bend elbows hands toward temples drawing straight body toward anchor, then extend leaning back.

items.name: Flexão de Punho na Polia Baixa
items.movement: Seated LOW cable WRIST FLEXION PALMS UP: forearms fully SUPINATED flat on horizontal bench, PALMS clearly FACE CEILING in ALL6poses. Wrists beyond edge hold straight bar connected low pulley front. Only wrists flex upward curling bar slightly, then extend down. NO rotation, no elbow movement. Close side view hand/forearms visible.

items.name: Suspensão Isométrica na Barra Fixa (Dead Hang - Bilateral ou Unilateral)
items.movement: DEAD HANG on overhead pullup bar: bilateral shoulderwidth overhand grip, elbows straight, body hanging vertical feet CLEAR FLOOR. Sequence approach on low step grip, step off into hang, hold hang, hold hang, return toes to step, supported grip. No pullup, show isometric hold.

items.name: Pinça de Anilhas (Plate Pinch Hold)
items.movement: PLATE PINCH HOLD: standing athlete holds TWO thin weight plates together SMOOTH SIDES OUT using thumb on one flat side and four fingers opposite side, hanging at right side. Six phases hand approaches plates on low stand, pinches, lifts plates slightly clear stand, HOLD same pose, lower, release. Close hand-focused view fixed plates shape.

items.name: Flexão Esfinge / Extensão de Tríceps no Solo ou Banco (Bodyweight Triceps Extension)
items.movement: SPHINX PUSHUP on mat: plank on forearms elbows under shoulders hands flat in front. Keep body straight, extend BOTH elbows lifting forearms off floor into high plank with hands in SAME positions, then lower forearms. No normal chest pushup.

items.name: Mergulho Sentado na Máquina (Triceps Dip Machine)
items.movement: Seated TRICEPS DIP MACHINE: seated upright back support, handles beside hips connected weighted lever arms. Start elbows bent90degrees hands near lower ribs, press handles DOWN beside hips by extending elbows, return. Torso fixed, not chest press.

items.name: Extensão de Tríceps no TRX / Fita de Suspensão
items.movement: SUSPENSION TRICEPS EXTENSION: standing facing AWAY from high anchor behind, body leans FORWARD straight head-to-heels, both hands grip handles in front, upper arms beside ears. Bend elbows hands near forehead lowering body forward, extend elbows to return. Feet planted, straps taut.

items.name: Panturrilha no Leg Press Horizontal
items.movement: HORIZONTAL LEG PRESS CALF RAISE: seated back supported on horizontal machine, legs almost straight horizontal, ONLY balls of both feet on LOWER EDGE of VERTICAL footplate. Plantarflex ankles pushing carriage horizontally then dorsiflex, knees fixed. No leg press knee bending.
